profile.headline: Java Software Engineer
profile.summary: OCA I/JSE 8 Java software engineer with a focus on web application development and UI/UX.  1 year Python experience.  15+ years of web development experience with acute working knowledge of React, Next.js, Node.js, MySQL, Redux, GraphQL, HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, CSS, PHP, Adobe CS/CC Suite, Microsoft Office & more.  Currently earning a Bachelor of Science degree in Software Engineering.  My professional experience has given me the interpersonal and time management skills necessary to meet project deadlines.

positions.title: Creative Operations Manager & Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Complete content management and development for websites as well as marketing materials including back and front end website maintenance, all visual assets, original copy writing, copy editing, newsletters, advertisements, social media, brand management and email campaigns.  Front and back end website development.  Collaboration with senior management to develop new marketing strategies, brands and services.

positions.title: Web Developer/Graphic Designer
positions.description: In-house graphic design including beverage labels, team apparel, website design + maintenance, packaging, product catalog and newsletter/blog management.  Created all graphics/artwork using Adobe Photoshop, Corel Painter and Adobe Illustrator.  Created a PHP employee login portal/intranet page for company functions.

positions.title: Customer Service & Accounting
positions.description: Managed driver payroll, worked directly under accounting manager to maintain financial records.  Used QuickBooks, Excel, QualComm Data & proprietary payroll software.

projects.title: Duo Solutions: Branding, Social Media Management, Website Development
projects.description: Complete branding package including logo designs, team apparel and business cards.  Development of website, ongoing updates, social media management and marketing.

projects.title: Rite Aid Advertising Campaign with ProVision
projects.description: Created a social media marketing campaign for rollout of new Rite Aid Pharmacy interactive advertising kiosks.  Created all graphics and copywriting, managed targeted ads on Twitter, Facebook, Adspace, worked with marketing company to tie in b2b phone campaign.
